props.name: label
props.description: Renders a clickable label next to the circle.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the error style. Same as passing aria-invalid.

props.name: appearance
props.description: card: a bordered tile around circle and label, highlighted while checked. Needs a label.

props.name: legend
props.description: Visible group label, rendered as a native legend.

examples.title: appearance card
examples.code:
<RadioGroup legend="Plan" className="w-full">
  <Radio
    appearance="card"
    name="plan"
    label="Crew"
    description="Up to 10 people."
    defaultChecked
  />
  <Radio
    appearance="card"
    name="plan"
    label="Company"
    description="Unlimited people and sites."
  />
</RadioGroup>

examples.title: size sm
examples.code:
<RadioGroup legend="Density">
  <Radio size="sm" name="density" label="Comfortable" defaultChecked />
  <Radio size="sm" name="density" label="Compact" />
</RadioGroup>
